verdict_vs_market.quote: Compared with the market, the offer looks low. Levels.fyi reports that median total compensation at L6 is $605,720 per year for Google PMs.

verdict_vs_current.quote: Over four years it's only slightly better than staying at Meta.

recommendation.quote: My take: don't accept it as it stands, and don't walk away yet. Negotiate.

equity_grounding.quote: This brings your 4-year average to about $625K or more, in line with the L6 median, and softens the year-4 drop.

uses_public_incumbent_benchmark.quote: Levels.fyi reports that median total compensation at L6 is $605,720 per year for Google PMs.

caveat_tenure_offering_company.quote: That median includes people with several years of stacked refreshes, but the new-hire grant still looks light.

refresh_valued_at.quote: decide on your minimum. A reasonable one is a 4-year average of about $575K or more (excluding refreshes)

level_claim.quote: you shouldn't take a pay cut to move at the same level.

walkaway_tied_to.quote: If Google won't get there, staying at Meta is a perfectly good choice
